description:
Search the web (GET /serp) and return organic results, plus search features in full mode.
Organic results carry position, title, link, snippet, domain, page, and
html_body/clean_html/links when output was requested.
API docs: https://apidocs.pline.ai/guides/endpoints/serp

country.description: Country code for localization, or "all". Default all.

mode.description:
fast = 1 credit, organic results only; full = 3 credits, adds knowledge graph, people-also-ask,
related searches, sitelinks. Default full.

only_main_content.description: Strip navigation and layout from enriched page content. Default true.

output.description: Also fetch each result page: any of html, clean_html, links. Best-effort, +1 credit per page.

tbs.description: Time filter: qdr:d (past day), qdr:w (past week), qdr:m (past month).

name: search
